observables.representation: actual native proposal in aligned receptor world angstrom
observables.anchor: predicted endpoint spatial weights, detached during each derivative
observables.channel: NOS based on fixed predicted endpoint hard labels
observables.feature_definition: For each of ASN117 and VAL116: Gaussian-weighted centroid relative to receptor-region point mean, plus weighted spread.
observables.derivative: gradient with respect to actual proposal coordinates only; no endpoint-model Jacobian, hard-type or bond derivative
observables.missing_feature_rule: No eligible NOS slots: mark unavailable, zero reward contribution and zero dose; native channels continue.

reference_contract.independent_unit: batch; clones and time nodes do not create additional independent replicates
reference_contract.selected: Per-batch moments weighted by the recorded selection probabilities, renormalized after the joint finite-feature mask.
reference_contract.background: Unweighted moments of the same finite-feature pre-resampling candidate pool; not the unguided FLOWR density.
reference_contract.regularization: Existing regularize_covariance(covariance, 0.1, std_floor_A=0.15), identical policy for selected and background.
reference_contract.mixture_weights: 1/14 for each batch representative; components are not recovered physical lineage or pose modes

new_reference_readonly_check.scope: Local reference integrity and parity inspection, not inference or physical validation.

formula.normalized_component: log phi_b(z) = -0.5 * ((z-mu_b)^T Sigma_b^-1 (z-mu_b) + logdet(Sigma_b) + D*log(2*pi)) - log(B)
formula.mixture: log p(z) = logsumexp_b(log phi_b(z)); selected and background use the same B=14 and D=8
formula.dimension_warning: Gaussian exponent uses full Mahalanobis squared distance. Division by D is used in q support statistics and KL amplitude, not in the Gaussian exponent.
formula.implementation: Float64 observables/density evaluation, Cholesky triangular solves, log determinants and logsumexp; coordinate gradient returns to incoming FLOWR dtype.

dose_gates.paired_KL: K_b = 0.5*(tr(Sigma_bg^-1 Sigma_sel) + delta_mu^T Sigma_bg^-1 delta_mu - D + logdet(Sigma_bg) - logdet(Sigma_sel))
dose_gates.small_roundoff_rule: Builder clamps tiny negative computed KL to zero; current reference was checked for finite nonnegative values.
dose_gates.dimension_normalized_average: k_t = mean_b(K_b)/D; divide by D exactly once
dose_gates.selection_amplitude_interpretation: Engineering amplitude from average paired Gaussian KL; not the actual mixture KL. The paired average upper-bounds equal-weight mixture KL and may include finite-sample covariance noise.
dose_gates.background_threshold_source: q90/q98 of actual unweighted same-batch, same-time candidate q values, using NumPy quantile default linear interpolation; no synthetic candidates or chi-square thresholds.
dose_gates.mixture_support: H_bg=sum_b posterior_bg,b(z)*h_b; posterior is softmax of normalized background log components
dose_gates.combined_gate: dose_gate = stop_gradient(G_sel * H_bg * S_bound); no old nearest-selected-residual dose gate is additionally applied
dose_gates.requested_injection_RMS_A: eta * calibration_RMS_A * dose_gate, followed by existing native-dtype gradient normalization, caps and geometry backtracking
dose_gates.weak_gradient_rule: Keep the existing coordinate gradient RMS threshold 1e-8; below it request no displacement. Do not rescale G_sel to unit mean or raise eta merely to cancel weak contrast.
dose_gates.unit_normalization_note: S_bound explicitly enters external amplitude because unit-normalizing gradient(R) alone would cancel tanh saturation. Gates are detached and do not add their own gradient directions.

support_degeneracy_and_fallback.degenerate_component: h_b=0 even at its center; do not invent an empirical support width
support_degeneracy_and_fallback.mixture_after_degeneracy: Keep original background posterior weights, including mass assigned to unusable components; do not renormalize usable components to restore full dose.
support_degeneracy_and_fallback.outside_support: When H_bg=0, zero coordinate injection and unchanged native proposal; native categorical sampling continues.
support_degeneracy_and_fallback.identical_selected_background: With identical moments and K_b=0, logratio/reward/coordinate gradient and dose_gate are zero.
support_degeneracy_and_fallback.zero_eta: Zero physical update with the original coordinate dtype; complete new-reward rollout equivalence remains to be established in FLOWR.
support_degeneracy_and_fallback.corrupt_reference: Missing keys or failed Cholesky are input failures, not scientific native-fallback observations. Current constructor checks required fields; complete finite/range validation for arbitrary external references is not yet automatic.
support_degeneracy_and_fallback.geometry_guard: Rejected added displacement becomes zero; existing native defects are not certified chemically valid by this guard.

exploratory_parameters.parameter_origin: Predeclared engineering choices, not affinity-fitted or physical constants.
exploratory_parameters.recommended_comparison_parent: Frozen R3/R6 joint eight-dimensional reference and control baseline; no round number or run is authorized by this document.

evaluation_and_limits: Evaluate actual x_0.5 independently of the reward, including both shape directions; a lower feature loss or higher density ratio is not success by itself.

At t=1 retain all candidate failures, validity/PB coverage, unique graphs, same-state head and valid-graph MMFF/surround relaxation coverage; head is a shared model prediction, not experimental affinity.
The reference background has undergone previous SMC. Subtracting it can discard useful accumulated structure as well as shared nuisance geometry.
Gaussian components are moment approximations. Sparse conditional NOS support, correlated regional views, genealogy collapse and 50 candidates per batch limit density and tail accuracy.
Only discovery batches 0–13 define this reward. Reused seed42 development batches do not provide heldout validation or evidence of unseen-seed generalization.
The new gate may deliberately yield very small or zero injection. Do not label lack of movement an implementation failure without checking measured support, KL and actual dose.
No extra neural model is fitted, but this is still empirical statistical fitting; it does not identify a unique optimal path, physical energy or regional causal mechanism.
